action.description: Office PDF job: create a memo/report, edit an existing PDF, extract text, or summarize it.

fileName.description: Base file name without extension, for example bao-cao-tuan-36.

docType.description: Office document kind for create. Default report.

title.description: Document title, cover heading, or stamp text context.

organization.description: Company or department name printed at the top of a created PDF.

text.description: Create body, stamp label (MAT, COPY), or cover/addendum wording.

content.description: Full chat-attachment text when it is visible in the conversation. Required for source platform because the app cannot download the PDF from Core. Pass the full text; do not summarize.

signer.description: Signatory name at the bottom of a created PDF.

signerTitle.description: Signatory role, for example Truong phong Hanh chinh.

editMode.description: How to edit: header/footer/watermark stamp, extra notes page, cover page, or keep a page range.

stampPosition.description: Stamp placement for editMode stamp. Default header.

pageStart.description: First 1-based page to keep for page-range.

pageEnd.description: Last 1-based page to keep for page-range.

source.description: Where the existing PDF comes from for edit, extract, or analyze.

fileId.description: Workspace fileId returned by a previous pdf create/edit.

platformFileId.description: Chat attachment fileId when the user attached a PDF.

pdfBase64.description: Raw PDF bytes as standard base64 when the file cannot be downloaded from chat.
